signs.title: The Longboats
signs.text: LONGBOATS. Pitcairn's longboats are built for the surf: long, narrow and rowed or motored through the gap at Bounty Bay to meet visiting ships. Boat crews are an island institution, and being chosen for one means you have been paying attention.

text: A chart of Pitcairn with the landing at Bounty Bay marked in pencil, and a note in the margin: aim for the gap.
The islanders descend from the Bounty mutineers and the Tahitians who settled here in 1790. The longboat is how everything and everyone comes ashore.
